title: Generative map (L0) schema v2: v1 fields plus optional template, module-profile and runtime-policy references

attempt.description: Optional. Seed stream used by the generator (0 = the seed itself; n regenerates with stream n after a rule such as branch_required failed).

layout_variant.description: Required by gmap-0.6.1. Deterministic site-aware layout search variant within the recorded attempt.

port_step_m.description: Optional (gmap-0.2.0). Grid step for port positions when finer than unit_m; default: unit_m.

floor_y.description: gmap-0.10.0: floor level in metres, one of -3.0, -1.5, 0, 1.5, 3.0. The spawn cell is 0.

placement.description: Optional (gmap-0.2.0), default standard. degenerate: the 2 m doorway touches an envelope corner (>= 1.5 m rule waived).

mode.description: Optional (gmap-0.2.0), default standard. degenerate: may carry corner-hugging doorways (rare, budgeted).

shape_stage_target.description: Optional (gmap-0.4.0). The shape stage drawn for this generated walkable cell (2: a stage-2 chamfered class, see shape_class_target).

shape_class_target.description: Optional (gmap-0.4.0). The stage-2 primitive class drawn for this cell; present exactly when shape_stage_target is 2.

wear.description: gmap-0.9.0: 0 clean, 1 worn, 2 damaged. Module and void cells carry none.

surface_variants.description: gmap-0.9.0: the selected clean/worn/damaged variant for each palette surface.

reverb.description: gmap-0.11.0: true = wet ringing room, false = dry room. One flag per walkable cell, shared by the cell's whole module or shape room; void cells carry none and the spawn cell is always dry.

palette.description: Optional (gmap-0.5.0). The material palette this generated walkable cell takes: the palette of the nearest placed library figure room (anchor_module_id, graph distance over open edges), a gmap-0.12.0 regional floor palette (region_seed_cell_id, region_distance), or the registry default (all null). Module and void cells carry none.

registry_version.description: Optional (gmap-0.12.0). The registry the palette id was resolved from; older maps default to 0.2.0.

region_seed_cell_id.description: Optional (gmap-0.12.0). The non-anchored seed cell whose regional floor palette this cell took.

region_distance.description: Optional (gmap-0.12.0). Graph distance from the region seed over open direct edges.

module.description: Optional (gmap-0.3.0). The library module placed in this leaf cell: world = R(local) + translation_xz, R = rotation_deg / 90 quarter turns (x, z) -> (-z, x).

connection_status.description: Optional (gmap-0.3.0). proposed_untested: a new joint (generated cell to a library module's tested socket) that no operator has walked; it never inherits the #160 / #168 pair approval.

vertical.description: gmap-0.10.0: level, bidirectional ramp, or one-way drop from upper to lower.

degenerate_budget.description: Optional (required by gmap-0.2.0 rules). Rare degenerate cells: at most max, used so far.

palette_registry.description: Optional (required by gmap-0.5.0 rules). The material palette registry the cell palettes were assigned from, with its hash.

reserved_diagonal_zones.description: gmap-0.6.1 growth-time sites; realized entries become links and released entries remain unoccupied.

module_budget.description: Optional (required by gmap-0.3.0 rules). Library modules placed as leaf cells: min..max allowed, used so far.

elevation_loops.description: gmap-0.10.0: non-tree level loop edges added so drops keep a return route.

reverb_layer.description: gmap-0.11.0: per-room wet/dry reverb parameters. Each cell's flag comes from its own sha256 keyed draw over seed, attempt, stream and cell_id, so one cell can be re-drawn without shifting the others; a later runtime mutation may flip a visited room.

floor_regions.description: gmap-0.12.0: regional floor-palette parameters. Seed cells and their palettes come from per-cell sha256 draws on the floor_regions stream, after the library-anchor rule; anchors win, and the spawn cell plus its direct neighbours are excluded.

metadata_records.description: Optional (gmap-0.3.0). The poetics record read for each library module (accepted record, else the draft), sorted by module_id.

direction8.description: Unit vector in one of eight directions: four cardinal, four diagonal (components +/-0.707107).

description: Generative map schema v2 from docs/GENERATIVE_MAP_TEMPLATE_PROPOSAL.md section 4.3. Every v2 addition is optional; committed gmap-0.1.0 through gmap-0.12.0 maps keep validating against generative_map.schema.json (schema v1).
